title: Local finite presentation is fppf local on the source
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and let $(h_i:U_i\to X)_{i\in I}$ be a jointly surjective family of flat morphisms [def-weil-flat-morphism] locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Then $f$ is locally of finite presentation if and only if every $f\circ h_i$ is locally of finite presentation. Jointly surjective means every point of $X$ has a preimage in some $U_i$. No quasi-compactness, separatedness or Noetherian assumption is imposed; empty schemes and an empty covering family of the empty scheme are allowed.

proof.text: If $f$ is locally of finite presentation, each $h_i$ followed by $f$ is locally of finite presentation by [lem-sbc-locally-finite-presentation-composition]. For the converse assume all composites are locally of finite presentation.

For every point $x$ of $X$, choose an index $i(x)$ and $y_x$ in $U_{i(x)}$ with $h_{i(x)}(y_x)=x$. This gives a family indexed by the point type of $X$, in the same universe as the schemes even when the original index type is larger. Form $Q=\coprod_{x\in X}U_{i(x)}$ and its induced map $q:Q\to X$ using [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family]. Each $x$ has the preimage obtained by applying its coprojection to $y_x$, so $q$ is surjective.

Flatness [def-weil-flat-morphism] and local finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation] are Zariski local on the source (the existing Mathlib IsZariskiLocalAtSource instances). Apply IsZariskiLocalAtSource.sigmaDesc to the component maps: $q$ is flat and locally of finite presentation. Coproduct uniqueness identifies $q$ followed by $f$ with the map induced by the $h_{i(x)}$ followed by $f$; applying sigmaDesc again shows this composite is locally of finite presentation. The coprojections are an open cover by [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family].

Apply [lem-trf-lfp-flat-surjective-source-descent] to $q$ and $f$. Its hypotheses are exactly the three properties of $q$ and local finite presentation of its composite established above. It gives local finite presentation of $f$. If $X$ is empty the chosen family is empty, the coproduct construction and its source-local properties still apply, and the same argument works without a nonemptiness assumption.

proof_origin.place: Shorter assembly of the proved LocallyOfFinitePresentation.of_comp_of_flat_of_surjective (Stacks 02KL) with Mathlib coproducts, IsZariskiLocalAtSource.sigmaDesc and Surjective.sigmaDesc_of_union_range_eq_univ. Select one family member per point to handle arbitrary index universes.
